blind.description: A single continuous spherical stone boulder featuring a textured rock surface. A distinct lighter-colored sedimentary band or stripe wraps horizontally around its equator. The surface is smooth and spherical without shards, holes, or floating elements. It rests directly on the ground at a single contact point with no added plinth or base.
blind.from_above: A uniform mottled brownish-grey textured circle or sphere casting a shadow toward the upper-left, with the equatorial stripe hidden along the sides.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3 to 3.5 feet in diameter, roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure, and about three to four times as wide as the figure's torso.
